newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cydsa says it will invest $36 mln in '97.
newsitem.headline: Cydsa says it will invest $36 mln in '97.

text.p: The pulp and petrochemical company Cydsa, based in the northern Mexico industrial center of Monterrey, will invest $36 million in fixed assets during 1997 for plant maintenance, the Monterrey newspaper El Norte reported on Tuesday.

But Tomas Gonzalez Sada, president and director general of the company, also said the budget could change during the course of the year depending on opportunities that might present themselves, El Norte reported. In any event, Gonzalez Sada said the company would seek to reduce its debt this year.
"This year will be a period of consolidation, although at the same time it will be one of analysis and planning for the future of Cydsa," Gonzalez Sada told the newspaper.
He said that 1998 would be the year that Cydsa becomes profitable enough to cover the cost of capital.
"This is returning to our stockholders the average of what they would receive in alternative investments," he said.
